configurations.name: esl-app
runtimeArgs: set -a; [ -f .env.project1.local ] && source .env.project1.local; set +a; export ESL_EVENT_LOG=/tmp/esl_app_events.log; exec conda run --no-capture-output -n project1 python -m streamlit run app.py --server.port 8501 --server.headless true

configurations.name: esl-replay
runtimeArgs: set -a; [ -f .env.project1.local ] && source .env.project1.local; set +a; export ESL_EVENT_LOG=/tmp/esl_replay_events.log; export REPLAY_SPEED=3; exec conda run --no-capture-output -n project1 python -m streamlit run replay_harness.py --server.port 8502 --server.headless true
